name: 98370 · Poulsbo, WA
findings: ZIP 98370 (Poulsbo) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98370 (Poulsbo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98370 (Poulsbo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
